claims: Miley Cyrus is currently celebrating the 20th anniversary of Hannah Montana with a special on Disney+ and Hulu.
The special features a new original song titled "Younger You".
The song "Younger You" features the lyrics "Hey you, it's younger you/ I'm just checking in to see if you still remember me".
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special was released in March 2026.
Miley Cyrus debuted the song "Younger You".
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes performances of classic hits.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes a rebuilt set.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes a guest appearance by Chappell Roan.
Miley Cyrus performed a stripped-down cover of Outkast's "Hey Ya!" in 2025.
